exposure: Antenatal depression (categorized as mild, moderate, and severe based on Zung Self-Rating Depression Scale scores)
cohort: 4,663 pregnant women between gestational ages of 12-20 weeks who completed the Chinese version of the Zung Self-Rating Depression Scale (SDS).
finding: Antenatal depression was associated with preterm birth (PTB) (particularly in severely depressed mothers), hyperthyroidism during pregnancy (in moderately depressed women), and cesarean section use (in women with mild depression).
